description: Figure 1 illustrates the similarity of Hash Set Attention (HSAs) across different languages for the Qwen1.5-1.8B model. The x-axis is labeled “tokens set T<sub>old</sub> and the indicator function F(t)<sub>t</sub>”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, and tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled “similarity”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. There is one line displayed, colored blue and solid. This line begins at approximately 0.25 at x=0, increases to a peak of approximately 0.98 at x=60, then declines to approximately 0.25 at x=100.
